title: Microframe streaming observability: per-segment metrics, span correlation, and redact-first logging
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: Instrument the streaming path so every emitted microframe (small contiguous output segment emitted to clients) produces lightweight, consistent telemetry: a per-microframe metrics event, an attachable tracing span that can be stitched to the request-level span, and redact-first logging for any content that would be persisted. This ticket covers runtime changes, API surface for span/context propagation, sampling defaults, redaction heuristics for streamed tokens (including tool/function call payloads and structured outputs), and a backward-compatibility shim for older clients that only understand whole-response events.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Every streaming request emits a per-microframe metrics event with latency, token_count, model_variant, batch_id, and route tags. 2) A short-lived span is started and finished for each microframe; spans include links to request and parent model execution spans and can be queried in trace UI. 3) Logged microframe payloads are redacted before persisting using PII/secret rules; redaction must run in fast-path and cannot increase p95 latency by >5ms. 4) Backward compat: clients that don't send stream-capability header receive same overall metrics but not microframe spans; documented in API changelog. 5) End-to-end tests and stress tests for 10k concurrent streams validate telemetry correctness and overhead <3% CPU on benchmark instance.
milestones: Design: microframe metric schema and span contract (done)
Runtime: emit metrics and spans for microframes (in progress)
Privacy: integrate redact-first pipeline into stream hot path (blocked by redaction lib review)
API: add stream-capability header and compatibility shim (planned)
telemetry_schema: metric tags: request_id, route, model, model_variant, customer_tier, batch_id, microframe_index
log entry fields: request_id, microframe_index, redaction_version, redact_tags_applied
span attributes: microframe_index, tokens_emitted, latency_ms, batch_id, kv_cache_hit
sampling_policy: Default: sample 1% of microframe spans across production by deterministic hash on request_id; for P0 customer tiers sample 100%; for error-coded frames (>=500 internal) force-sample. Configurable via runtime flags.
span_contract: Parent: request-level span_id is attached to every microframe span via parent_link
Span duration should cover the time between first token emission and last token emission for that microframe
Spans must attach attribute 'microframe_probe' when emitted under debug mode
Correlation: add 'trace.link.request_chunk' tag equal to request_id + ':' + microframe_index
redaction_rules: Run redact-first pipeline in hot path: apply token-level regex safe list + classifier-based PII tagger
Tool/function call payloads: sanitize tool arguments and only persist tool metadata by default; full payload persists only when allow_tool_persist=true
Structured outputs (JSON blobs): schema-aware redaction - remove values for known PII keys (email, ssn) and mask long strings >256 chars
Audit: record redaction_reason and redaction_version in span attributes and logs
compatibility_notes: Add 'X-RW-Stream-Capabilities' request header; older clients without header will not produce microframe spans but will still increment aggregated request metrics
Provide server-side aggregator that emits a synthetic 'response.complete' metric for older clients to preserve dashboards
Graceful degrade: if the client closes the stream early, emit final microframe with ended=true attribute
comments: 2025-02-15 Maya Chen: Created ticket after design workshop with infra and privacy teams. Drafted metric schema and initial span contract. Asked security to review redact-first approach.

2025-02-18 Arjun Patel: Implemented initial metric emitter in prototype branch. Observed +1.2% CPU on benchmark n1-standard during 5000 concurrent streams. Pushed PR for early review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4851
2025-02-20 Priya Rao (Privacy): Reviewed redaction rules; recommended adding classifier-based PII tagger and an allowlist for internal-only keys. Requested benchmark of redaction latency.

2025-02-24 Samir Gupta (SRE): Load test notes: microframe emission at 10k concurrent streams produced spiky metric ingestion; recommend batching metric writes per-100ms window to reduce backend load. Filed ENG-21200 to tune metric exporter.

2025-02-27 Arjun Patel: Switched metric exporter to buffered writes (100ms) in prototype; end-to-end p95 latency increased by ~2.7ms due to buffering but CPU decreased. Added unit tests for span attribute propagation.
2025-03-01 Design feedback (Laura Ng): For structured outputs we should include a schema registry reference in span attributes when available. Added 'schema_ref' attribute to contract.
2025-03-02 Security review (internal): Initial OK but flagged cryptographic audit for redaction keys if KMS is used for reversible redaction. Security review scheduled for 2025-03-10.

2025-03-03 Arjun Patel: Merged metric emitter behind feature flag 'microframe-telemetry-v1'. Running canary in us-west-2 with 5% traffic. Next: finalize redaction lib upgrade and add API header for client capability negotiation.
